input.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap to Section 15.11 measured by twelve months of identified payments (SFJ's Development Costs and PB's Article 6 / Section 14.2 payments), with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct carved out.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 15.11 excludes consequential damages but leaves each Party's direct liability wholly uncapped, so we added our fallback position: a mutual cap measured by the twelve months of payments actually made under this Agreement (SFJ's Development Costs and PB's Article 6 and Section 14.2 payments), with indemnification, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap.

ops.text: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement will not exceed the sum of (a) the Development Costs paid or incurred by SFJ and (b) the amounts paid or payable by PB to SFJ under Article 6 and Section 14.2, in each case during the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's indemnification obligations, breach of its confidentiality obligations, gross negligence and willful misconduct.
